page.layout: One column of text, centred under a heading; below it a two-line dedication signature and a name; a woodcut ornament at the foot (not text).

p.i: clesiæ, Scholæ & Reipublicæ Christianæ diu bene valentem & florentem conser-vet, ex animo precor atque opto. Steinfurti ex Museo meo, calendis Ianuar. Anno æræ Christianæ 1604.

page.notes: The first word is printed "clesiæ" with the initial letter apparently cut off or lost in the scan; it is most likely "Ecclesiæ" but is transcribed as it appears. "tiex" is printed without a space between "ti" and "ex" (a printing error, left as printed in the line break, read as "tiex" in the text above is corrected to "ti ex" only in the hyphenated form; the printed spacing is uncertain). Long s is rendered as plain s throughout, and "Musfeo" is read as "Museo". The woodcut ornament below the name is not text and is omitted. The faint "Google" mark at the bottom right is a digitiser's watermark and is omitted.
